subject.title: fix(reef): bound legacy state file reads in doctor migration

question: Should Reef doctor preserve migration of arbitrarily large valid legacy audit/replay history through bounded incremental import, or intentionally reject files above a documented limit with a supported recovery path?
rationale: The branch changes upgrade behavior for persisted user state, and repository policy treats migration and compatibility behavior as an explicit product contract rather than an implementation convenience.

options.title: Use bounded incremental migration
options.body: Refactor the legacy import to process valid large records without a whole-file allocation, preserving existing user history during doctor migration.

options.title: Adopt an explicit migration limit
options.body: Keep a finite limit only with a documented recovery/export path and maintainer acceptance that oversized legacy state will not be migrated automatically.

recommendation.title: Use bounded incremental migration
recommendation.body: Refactor the legacy import to process valid large records without a whole-file allocation, preserving existing user history during doctor migration.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the proposed migration change, but current-main Reef ownership could not be established from the available evidence.
